reports.title: Kerala Floods — Alappuzha District Villages Submerged, IAF Helicopter Rescue Ops Active
reports.description: Catastrophic flooding in Alappuzha, Ernakulam and Pathanamthitta districts following 3 days of record monsoon rainfall. Over 120 villages completely submerged — only rooftops and coconut tree crowns visible. More than 48,000 people stranded. Indian Air Force ALH Dhruv helicopters and NDRF rescue boats conducting round-the-clock evacuations. Kuttanad backwater region inundated. Red alert issued for 9 districts. 14 major dams have opened shutters simultaneously, compounding the crisis. Kerala State Disaster Management Authority has activated EOC. IMD forecasts continued heavy rain for 48 hours.
reports.moderation_reason: Genuine large-scale disaster. IAF rescue ops confirmed. Red alert issued across 9 districts.

reports.title: Uttarakhand Cloudburst Flash Floods — Rishikesh–Badrinath NH-58 Washed Away, 2 Bridges Gone
reports.description: Catastrophic cloudburst over Chamoli and Rudraprayag districts triggered massive flash floods on the Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers. NH-58 (Rishikesh–Badrinath Highway) destroyed over 400 metres near Srinagar Garhwal. Two major suspension bridges swept away. Over 2,200 Char Dham pilgrims stranded in Kedarnath valley without road access. SDRF teams doing rope-bridge evacuations. Army helicopters deployed from Jolly Grant Airport. Tehri district also affected — Bhilangana valley villages cut off. The swollen Bhagirathi has risen 6 metres above danger mark at Rishikesh.

reports.title: Super Cyclone Landfall Puri — 175 km/h Winds Flatten Coastal Odisha, 40 Lakh Without Power
reports.description: Super Cyclone made landfall near Puri, Odisha with sustained winds of 175 km/h and gusts exceeding 200 km/h. Entire coastal belt from Konark to Chilika devastated. Over 1.8 lakh tin-roof houses collapsed. Massive trees uprooted across Puri, Bhubaneswar and Cuttack districts. Power grid completely down across 14 districts — 40 lakh people without electricity. Puri–Konark Marine Drive destroyed. Storm surge of 3–5 metres inundated coastal villages up to 10 km inland. 11 lakh people were pre-evacuated by Odisha SDRF. IMD issued Cyclone Warning Level 5.
reports.moderation_reason: Major verified cyclone landfall. IMD Cyclone Alert Level 5 confirmed. Senior-reviewed.

reports.title: Mumbai Extreme Monsoon Flooding — Kurla, Sion, Dharavi Inundated; Local Trains Suspended
reports.description: IMD issued Red Alert after 294 mm of rain fell in 24 hours — second highest ever for Mumbai. Kurla, Sion, Dharavi and Chembur submerged under 4–6 feet of water. Several BEST buses stranded mid-road on Lal Bahadur Shastri Road. Central and Harbour railway lines fully suspended. CSMT–Thane route waterlogged. Airport operations disrupted with 60+ flights diverted to Pune and Ahmedabad. BMC deployed emergency pumps at 12 critical spots. Multiple vehicles swept away at King's Circle underpass. Mithi River has breached danger mark at Kurla.
reports.moderation_reason: Major urban flooding confirmed by IMD Red Alert and multiple citizen witnesses.

reports.title: Massive Landslide Blocks Manali–Leh Highway at Rohtang — 800 Vehicles, 2,400 People Trapped
reports.description: A catastrophic cloudburst-triggered landslide has buried 350 metres of the Manali–Leh NH-3 near Rohtang Pass at Koksar in Lahaul-Spiti. Enormous boulders and mud cover the road under 12 metres of debris. Over 800 vehicles including tourist cars, army trucks and buses are stranded. Approximately 2,400 civilians and tourists cannot move in either direction. BRO JCB machines pressed into emergency clearance. The Chandra River alongside is rising due to a debris-dam effect, threatening flash flood. Mobile connectivity lost in affected zone.

reports.title: Magnitude 5.8 Earthquake Strikes Kutch Gujarat — 6 Buildings Collapsed in Bhuj, NDRF Deployed
reports.description: A magnitude 5.8 earthquake struck Bhuj district of Kutch, Gujarat at 04:23 IST with epicentre 25 km NW of Bhuj city. Tremors felt across Ahmedabad, Rajkot, Jamnagar and Gandhinagar. Six multi-storey residential buildings in Bhuj's Jubilee Colony and Shiv Shakti Society have collapsed. NDRF teams with sniffer dogs deployed from Gandhinagar. 3 confirmed dead, 47 injured and rescue operations underway to locate trapped victims. Gujarat CM declared state emergency. The region falls in Seismic Zone V — the highest risk zone in India. NCS (National Centre for Seismology) has confirmed magnitude and depth of 10 km.
reports.moderation_reason: Confirmed M5.8 earthquake. NDRF deployed. Multiple building collapses verified.

reports.title: Uttarakhand Forest Fires — 3,200 Hectares Burning in Nainital & Almora, IAF Helicopters Deployed
reports.description: Rapid-spreading forest fires have consumed over 3,200 hectares of pine and oak forest across Nainital, Almora and Pauri Garhwal districts. Strong westerly winds at 40–60 km/h are fanning flames. Dense smoke has engulfed Nainital town and Corbett National Park buffer zone. Bhimtal and Sattal tourist areas under evacuation advisory. Uttarakhand Forest Department fire crews and 4 IAF MI-17 helicopters dropping water buckets deployed. Wildlife fleeing toward village areas. 15 villages in the fire corridor have been evacuated as a precaution.
reports.moderation_reason: Scale of fire unverified — requires senior moderator cross-check with Forest Department records.

reports.title: Severe Andhi Dust Storm Engulfs Jaisalmer — 95 km/h Winds, Zero Visibility, 85,000 Homes Without Power
reports.description: A massive andhi (dust storm) with gusts up to 95 km/h has engulfed Jaisalmer and Bikaner districts. Visibility dropped to near-zero within minutes. Hundreds of trees uprooted, power lines down across the city, mobile towers toppled. All camel safari operations suspended. Tourists at Sam Sand Dunes resort stranded. Jaisalmer Fort outer walls reported structurally damaged. IMD station recorded 95 km/h sustained winds. District administration closed all schools. Power outage affecting approximately 85,000 households. Rajasthan State Disaster Management Authority deployed 8 relief teams.
